trace.question: How long do we have to dispute a missing-item chargeback on a DoorDash order?
trace.answer:
Your policies don't give a dispute deadline for DoorDash chargebacks. They say Ridgeline Coffee isn't on any delivery marketplace, including DoorDash, Uber Eats and Grubhub. Anyone who asks about those should be told we aren't on them [Online Ordering and Loyalty Policy §2, Delivery Marketplaces]. I also found no marketplace terms covering chargeback or dispute windows.

If you've received a DoorDash chargeback notice, check it against your own records before acting on it. The deadline would be in the notice or in DoorDash's own terms, which I don't have.
